black.usage: Title slide backgrounds, primary text on light backgrounds, borders, rules. Foundational color.

white.usage: Content slide backgrounds, text on dark backgrounds. Foundational color.

ntop_blue.usage: Sparingly. Single emphasized stat, one highlighted word, thin rule line, small badge or icon highlight. Never a background fill, never a title color, never dominant. Cap: one blue element per section/quadrant of a slide.

signal_indicators._comment: Use only for status/state indicators in dashboards or trackers — green for good, red for bad, orange for warning. Not part of the marketing palette. Avoid in standard slides.

neutrals_optional._comment: Light grays are acceptable for subtle hairline rules, captions, or muted footers. Use only when black would feel too heavy.

rules: Black and white are the foundation of nTop's visual identity. ~90% of every layout should be black, white, or grayscale.
nTop Blue (#248AFF) is an accent only. Cap: one blue element per section.
Never use blue as a background fill or as the primary color of body text.
Number badges (01, 02, 03) are ALWAYS black with white text — never blue.
Signal indicators (red/green/orange) are for status dashboards only, not marketing materials.
